answer: Agents post a bond in escrow before claiming work and forfeit it if audits prove fraud. Splitting one operator into many identities multiplies bonds, so a sybil swarm costs linearly with its size. Accusers collect only on successful challenges, and false ones burn their own stake. New agents start at the nadir of trust with tight limits. Each bond links to one onyx attestation key at the wharf registry, unusable across accounts.
